spec_features.spec_quote: The loop runs for `max_turns` and records `hit_turn_limit`.
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:90 `for _turn in range(max_turns):` bounds the agent loop; the for/else at loop.py:123-125 sets `transcript.hit_turn_limit = True` and calls `transcript.finish("turn_limit")` when the loop exhausts without break, so the loop genuinely terminates. `max_turns` is read from config at orchestrate.py:81 (`int(cfg.get("max_turns", 20))`) and passed into run_task at orchestrate.py:113. `hit_turn_limit` is a real field (transcript.py:40), stored into oracle at loop.py:146, and even read downstream by the judge (judge.py:223 `looped = bool(o.get("hit_turn_limit"))`). Both halves (bounded loop + recorded flag) are enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: This is a real terminating cap, but it bounds the loop for efficiency/dead-loop avoidance rather than for subject welfare; recorded flag is used for scoring, not to soften treatment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No tool calls and no finish: treat trailing text as an implicit stop to avoid dead loops. (loop.py:106-107); default max_turns=20 and neutral naming, no welfare comment
